CONTROLLED PLAN VARIANT, never a headline value. enable_presorted_aggregate=off. THIS IS Q16's F_plan ANCHOR. It removes exactly one plan element -- ps_suppkey from the grouping sort key -- leaving every other node and every printed cost byte-identical, and thereby forces PostgreSQL onto CUBRID's aggregation shape (3-key sort + per-group tuplesort). 1.112363 s here vs 1.196902 s native = F_plan 0.929368x, i.e. CUBRID's shape is 7.06% FASTER for PostgreSQL than the shape PostgreSQL's own optimizer picks. This variant is ALSO the controlled leg on which F_units and F_cpu are computed.
